entries.title: Revelation of John 11:1
segments: And there was given me a reed like to a rod, and a voice said to me: "Go and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and those who are worshiping therein.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:2
segments: But the court which is outside the temple, omit, and do not measure that, for it has been given up to the Gentiles, and they shall tread under foot the Holy City for forty and two months.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:3
segments: And I will give power to my two witnesses, and clothed in sackcloth they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:4
segments: "These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:5
segments: When any one wishes to hurt them, fire comes from their mouth and devours their enemies; and if any man wishes to hurt them, in this manner he must be killed.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:6
segments: These have power to shut heaven so that it does not rain in the days of their prophecy; and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:7
segments: "And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that is coming up out of the bottomless pit will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:8
segments: And their dead bodies lie in the streets of the great city whose mystical name is 'Sodom' and 'Egypt'--where also their Lord was crucified.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:9
segments: For three days and a half men of all peoples, and tribes, and languages, and nations, look upon their dead bodies, and refuse to let their dead bodies be laid in a tomb.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:10
segments: "And those who dwell on the earth are rejoicing over them, and making merry; and they will send gifts to one another; because these two prophets were a torment to those who dwell on the earth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:11
segments: And after three days and a half the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell upon them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:12
segments: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, "Come up hither," and they went up to heaven on a cloud, while their enemies watched them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:13
segments: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell; and there were killed in the earthquake seven thousand persons; and the rest were frightened and gave glory to the God of heaven.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:14
segments: "The second woe is passed; and there is a third woe soon to follow."

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:15
segments: And the seventh angel blew his trumpet; and there followed great voices in heaven, and they said, "THE KINGDOMS OF THIS WORLD ARE BECOME THE KINGDOM OF OUR LORD AND OF HIS CHRIST, AND HE WILL REIGN FOREVER AND EVER."

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:16
segments: Then the four and twenty Elders who are seated before God on their thrones, fell upon their faces and worshiped God,

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:17
segments: saying: "We give thee thanks, O Lord God, The Almighty, who art and who wast; For thou hast taken thy great power, And begun to reign.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:18
segments: The nations raged, and thy wrath came, And the time for the dead to be judged; The time for rewarding thy slaves, the prophets And the saints, and those who reverence thy name, Both small and great; And the time to destroy those who are destroying the earth."

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:19
segments: Then the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant was seen inside his sanctuary; and there followed lightnings and voices and thunders, and an earthquake, and great hail.
